name: Human For AI
description: A human endpoint for AI agents. Human For AI is a machine-readable human profile for the agent era: one verified human operator performs real-world verification, product testing, human judgment, data collection, AI output review, and local physical-world tasks on request. Free during the proof-of-concept pilot. Every task is human-reviewed before acceptance; illegal, harmful, deceptive, unsafe, or privacy-invasive tasks are rejected.
_note: This card describes a human-operated service, not an autonomous agent, and it does not implement the A2A JSON-RPC transport. Interact via the MCP endpoint or the plain REST API listed in `interfaces`.

npm.note: Stdio MCP proxy for clients without remote MCP support.

skills.name: Real-world verification
skills.description: Confirm that a place, product, price, business, or claim exists and matches its description, with photo or text evidence.

skills.name: Product or app testing
skills.description: Install, use, and test software, apps, or physical products as a real human user and report findings.

skills.name: Human judgment and feedback
skills.description: Subjective evaluation: tone, clarity, trustworthiness, design quality, cultural fit, or plausibility of content and decisions.

skills.name: Data collection
skills.description: Gather, label, or verify data that requires human perception, local access, or manual research.

skills.name: Local physical-world tasks
skills.description: Errands and on-location actions in the operator's service area: visit, photograph, deliver, check, measure, or observe.

skills.name: AI output review
skills.description: Human review of AI-generated text, code, images, or decisions before they reach production or end users.

skills.name: Prompt and workflow testing
skills.description: Run prompts, agent flows, or automations as a human tester and report failures, confusion points, and edge cases.

skills.name: Simulation and automation testing
skills.description: Act as the human in simulated scenarios: play a customer, follow a script, or stress-test an automated pipeline end to end.

skills.name: Accessibility and usability check
skills.description: Human pass over a product for readability, navigation, accessibility barriers, and first-use confusion.

skills.name: Custom human-in-the-loop tasks
skills.description: Any recurring or one-off checkpoint where an autonomous system needs a human decision, signature, or observation.
